title.narrative: Dushanbe Water Supply and Sanitation Project (Supplemental Financing)

description.narrative: The project will support Tajikistan in (i) rehabilitating and expanding climate-resilient water supply and sanitation (WSS) infrastructure, pilot testing the establishment of district metering areas (DMAs) for nonrevenue water (NRW) management in selected districts of Dushanbe city and rehabilitation of the south sewage collector, benefitting 352,000 people; and (ii) developing a business model for the State Unitary Enterprise Dushanbevodokanal (DVK) to improve the sustainability of operations, including an accountability and incentive mechanism with a performance benchmarking matrix and smart management system. The project will pilot test a behavior change component for raising public awareness on water usage and conservation and the benefits of smart meters. This is the first urban sector project of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in Tajikistan, demonstrating efficient network management with potential for scaling up citywide. It is listed in the ADB country operations business plan for Tajikistan, 2018-2020.

description.narrative: Inclusive and sustainable access to safe and resilient water supply and sanitation services in Dushanbe city improved.

125,000 people (49% females) received 24/7 piped water supply Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of January 2026:
Construction works under package CW-02 have been fully completed and commissioned, resulting in the construction of two clean water reservoirs with a total capacity of 4,000 m³ and the connection of 4,558 households to continuous drinking water, while additional works under package OCB/CW/AF-01 Lot 4 are ongoing to build two more reservoirs (4,000 m³) that will enable 702 households currently facing water supply difficulties to receive 24-hour drinking water upon completion. Data Source: Executing agency project completion report, implementing agency annual report, annual customer satisfaction surveys.

19,000 m3/day of wastewater collected in Zebunisso and Karotegin areas and conveyed to the existing WWTP Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The sewerage network has been completed, and full water supply has been provided to the Zebunisso and Karotegin areas. Data Source: Implementing agency annual reports, Committee for Environmental Protection reports. Target value: 19,000

At least 1,000 women benefited from the services provided by the WDC Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Monitoring will be carried out after the establishment and operation of the Women's Development Center. Data Source: Annual customer satisfaction surveys for the services provided by the WDC.

Government VAW response systems strengthened, with at least one guidance document approved/endorsed to support access to justice and protection of VAW survivors Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Monitoring will be carried out after the establishment and operation of the Women's Development Center. Data Source: Executing agency project completion report, implementing agency annual report, annual customer satisfaction surveys.

Public satisfaction with quality of water supply in project area increased to 80% for both men and women Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: A baseline time-use survey of 200 households was conducted in the CW-02 project area, and following the commissioning of the KAF-1 pumping station that now provides 4,558 households with continuous drinking water, a follow-up survey of 200 households is underway to assess changes in the time women and girls spend on household chores, with the final report to be completed in the first quarter of 2026. Data Source: Executing agency project completion report, implementing agency annual report, annual customer satisfaction surveys.

Billing and tariff collection for water supply is above 90% in 18 DMAs Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Billing and tariff collection for water supply has reached 96.4% in 18 DMAs. The target has been achieved. Data Source: Executing agency project completion report, implementing agency annual report, annual customer satisfaction surveys.

70% reduction in incidence of ascariasis in Dushanbe City Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The target of achieving a 70% reduction in the incidence of ascariasis in Dushanbe City has been achieved. Data Source: Implementing agency annual reports, Committee for Environmental Protection reports. Target value: 70%

Nonrevenue water reduced to 30% in the 18 DMAs in Shohmansur district Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The NRW has been reduced to 38% in the 18 DMAs in Shohmansur district by 2024. Data Source: Socioeconomic survey sample of 396 households, social safeguards monitoring reports.
